title: Controller menu
summary: Editable local-player and controller settings UI.

blocks.text: This module renders the Players and Controllers tabs in the flight controls dialog. It provides the input.controller-menu service through the CONTROLLER_MENUS key. The Players tab configures local splitscreen multiplayer (1 to 4 seats), player names, input device assignments, and per-seat HUD navball locations. The Controllers tab configures stick deadzones, axis assignments and inversions, button mappings, and live hardware diagnostic meters. It operates gracefully without gamepad hardware, disabling live button capture while keeping layout editing fully functional. It does not advance simulation time or step physics worlds. When the split controller reports singleView, the Players tab shows one active seat and disables count/layout changes with an explanation. Saved split settings are retained for unrestricted game/renderer combinations.

items: Provides input.controller-menu@1.0.0 through the CONTROLLER_MENUS key: factory creating controller and local-player settings menus.
Requires input.local-pilots@^1.0.0 for player seat preference codecs and device assignments.
Requires input.flight-profiles@^1.0.0 for default controller layouts and profile normalization.
Requires input.flight-actions@^1.0.0 for action display labels.
Requires input.gamepad@^1.0.0 (optional) for live axis and button diagnostics and button capture; button names fall back to numbers when absent.

blocks.text: When a supplied FlightGamepad reports captureId, diagnostic reads reuse the most recently sampled input frame while the host continues updating controls. Older or standalone providers without that optional identity are read fresh. The menu does not create a global device cache or take over another owner’s sampling; removal still cancels its UI callbacks and disposes only resources it owns.

items: Initialization resolves local pilot, flight profile, and flight action services, then provides the CONTROLLER_MENUS factory.
create mounts into a caller-provided root element and injects scoped CSS styles. If no gamepads manager is supplied, it creates and owns an internal FlightGamepad when input.gamepad is present.
open initializes tab views, synchronizes player selection, and starts a requestAnimationFrame loop to update live axis meters and button activity indicators.
Closing the dialog or pressing Escape cancels active button captures and halts the animation loop.

dispose detaches DOM markup, removes injected style elements, unbinds window listeners, and disposes any owned gamepad manager. Provider disposal closes all open menus with an AggregateError if cleanup fails.

blocks.text: Games without local multiplayer or customizable controller layouts can omit this module. To replace it, implement a platform-tier module providing input.controller-menu@1.0.0 with your custom controls UI.
Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze: menu options, services, and markup conventions may change before API freeze.

examples/modules/controller-menu is a creator example implementing a minimal replacement provider for input.controller-menu@1.0.0 that manipulates local player preferences headlessly. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/controller-menu/module.json /tmp/controller-menu-example.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/controller-menu-example.spacemod
Code modules: manifests, packaging and installation
game-api flight-view.ts: controller menu and splitscreen view contracts

Live axis meters and button indicators retain their DOM nodes while the selected device and channel counts are unchanged. Device/channel changes rebuild the diagnostic nodes; absent devices clear them once. Open menus update values in place, and closing or disposing a menu stops its diagnostic RAF work. Capture IDs reuse the selected provider snapshot; older providers retain their fresh-sampling fallback.
